description: This file defines enumeration types, classes, and delegates related to handling problems encountered while reading PDF files in the PDFsharp library. It includes configurations for problem behaviors, problem types, and options to specify how problems should be handled during PDF reading.

classes.name: PdfReaderProblemDetails
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a specific problem encountered during PDF reading, including its type, title, description, and behavior.

classes.name: PdfReaderOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration options for how PDFsharp handles problems encountered during PDF reading, including problem behaviors and callback delegate.

methods.name: ReaderProblemDelegate
methods.description: Delegate used for callback when a problem is encountered during PDF reading.
